answer: Work waits on the quartz until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the inlet of the next round. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The pulse of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
